item.title: JAWS Retro Edition
item.description: A re-release of the 1987 NES Jaws game with modern quality-of-life upgrades (save anywhere, rewind, music player, trophies/achievements, gallery). Enhanced Edition – a greatly expanded multi-chapter adventure with new objectives, weapons, enemies and deeper progression.
